title.zh: 【79AU 运营热钱包疑似私钥泄露，损失约 1250 万美元】
title.en: 【79AU 运营热钱包疑似私钥泄露，损失约 1250 万美元】

current_state.zh: The 79th Vault (79AU) on BNB Chain lost approximately $12.5M after a suspected operating hot-wallet private key leak, with the attacker dumping 2.01M 79AU back into the pool and cashing out 16,249 BNB while draining pool USDT reserves from $15.2M to $3.9M.
